Manual smoke on REAL scheduled tasks (bound to profiles WITH an ocAgent) still failed: (A) Theological-Researcher (session_selectable=0 -> mode:subagent) throws opencode 'Agent not found' when AgentRunner forwards agent:ocAgent; (B) AI-Trend-Researcher (session_selectable=1 -> mode:primary) returns empty output. Coverage gap: the live probe should have driven a real profile-bound scheduled task, not only the optimizer path.
